prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Design a complete original front book cover 1024x1536 portrait, flat edge-to-edge artwork, no book mockup. Portuguese literary novel "DOM CASMURRO", author "MACHADO DE ASSIS". Art direction: sophisticated Brazilian midcentury modernist editorial screenprint, sharp asymmetrical composition in cobalt blue, warm vermilion, cream paper and near black. Large abstract almond eye formed by geometric cut-paper wave shapes becomes the central symbol of ambiguous memory and jealousy; no literal scenic landscape, no realism, no colonial postcard. Title is the dominant graphic object, heavy narrow grotesk sans-serif in three offset stacked lines DOM / CAS / MURRO with every letter present, confident optical spacing and full legibility at small thumbnail. Put author in modest but legible monospaced uppercase along upper left, horizontal. Geometric waves at lower right subtly echo the eye, crisp two-color print overprint, subtle paper fibers. Lots of intentional graphic negative space. Text only title and author, accurate Portuguese. No subtitles, no publisher logos, no border frame. This should feel like a bold acclaimed literature redesign, not a generic AI fantasy cover.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a complete original front cover for Brazilian historical novel "O GUARANI" with "JOSÉ DE ALENCAR" and small "VOLUME 1". 1024x1536 portrait, flat full cover, no mockup. Art direction: an elegant nineteenth-century botanical copperplate engraving reinterpreted as a fine two-ink literary edition, indigo ink and muted copper on pale ivory. Intricately engraved giant forest branches, palm fronds, vines and the curving Paquequer river form an airy oval vignette occupying upper two thirds. Tiny canoe silhouette far beneath the huge trees emphasizes scale; no buildings, generic mountain sunset, photorealism, or cartoon figures. Fine hatch marks and delicate botanical details, rich ivory negative space around the scene. Typography unlike an ordinary title-at-top cover: author name in small refined uppercase at top center, title very large dark-indigo classical italic serif occupying lower quarter in two offset lines O / GUARANI, with one exquisitely drawn long calligraphic G swash; every letter clearly readable, volume below in small capitals. Decorative flourishes restrained, no full perimeter border, no extra text or publisher branding. Exquisite classical print, beautiful readable bookshop cover.
